periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique diagonal orientation, angled approximately 60 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval geometry with a vertical-to-horizontal ratio significantly greater than 1:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering with the lowest point extending toward the muzzle.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped posterior boundary with minimal indentation at the spine.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Broad band, covering approximately 35-40% of the visible dorsal-to-lateral torso area.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral separation between the dark semi-circular ear regions across the cranial vault.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly curved, convex semicircular top boundary.
